title: Scattering Across the Long-Range Threshold for One-Dimensional Nonlinear Schrödinger Equations
summary: We study small solutions to the one-dimensional nonlinear Schrödinger family \[ \mathrm{i}\partial_t u_δ=-\partial_x^2u_δ+κ|u_δ|^{2+δ}u_δ, \qquad 0\leqδ\leqδ_0, \] uniformly as $δ\to0^+$ and $t\to\infty$, across the threshold between cubic modified scattering and nearby-power ordinary scattering. For initial data small in $H^{0,1}(\mathbb{R})$, with one spatial weight and no physical derivative assumed, we prove a joint-limit asymptotic formula governed by an explicit nonlinear clock.
